subsetPolicyRationale: `s.puzzle.2d@1` is this plugin's own self-contained 2D puzzle document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-node, delete-node, move-node, replace-node-geometry, change-node-kind, edit-node-text, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
